description: Atomic γ-4a SCXML invoke — sce_runtime/invoke.py introduces Invoke ABC + ScxmlInvoke wrapper; Engine grows `_pending_invokes` / `_active_invokes` + the W3C 6.4 defer-execute lifecycle (defer at onentry, execute after macrostep settle, tick + drain children on advance_time, cancel on exit, autoforward on external dispatch). Generated policies override `defer_invokes_on_entry` / `execute_pending_invokes` / `cancel_invokes_for_state` / `forward_to_autoforward_children` / `get_event_from_name`, and `<send target="#_parent">` lowers to a `_parent_queue` push (delay > 0 routes through the child's scheduler so terminated children drop pending parent sends per W3C 6.2). Hybrid (`srcexpr`/`contentexpr`) and mesh-rpc invokes stay reject-walled.
